name: 订单应付金额快照合计（不等于收款或GMV）
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_count,SUM(actual_amount) AS total_value FROM {{ecommerce_resource_order}}

name: 有到账时间的支付流水金额
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_count,SUM(payment_amount) AS total_value FROM {{ecommerce_resource_payment}} WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL

name: 已完成售后记录实际退款金额
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_count,SUM(refund_amount) AS total_value FROM {{ecommerce_resource_after_sales_case}} WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL

name: 有效预占记录的缺货数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_count,SUM(backorder_quantity) AS total_value FROM {{ecommerce_resource_inventory_reservation}} WHERE status = 'active'
